snippet.title: Shop Crush - Visual Novel and Shop Simulator with a Horror Twist
snippet.description:
Kyiv-based indie game studio Bsl Team presents the new trailer for Shop Crush.

Run a mysterious thrift shop in a story-rich Visual Novel. Meet eccentric customers, uncover hidden illusions, and unveil the sinister secret of your shop.

In this game, you:

• Manage your Thrift Shop: meet new clients, buy products, and balance your profit with reputation.
• Study customers' tastes, habits, and preferences, and trade wisely.
• Find all customers' secrets by unveiling illusions - special images with double meanings, inspired by the Literal Illusions effect.

The new trailer showcases the shop management mechanics, client interactions, and the unique illusion mode that unveils secrets woven into the shop and its visitors.

Bsl Team is a Ukrainian studio from Kyiv, known for creating bold, narrative-driven games with vibrant visuals. Their new project, Shop Crush, is already available on Steam, Epic Games Store, and other platforms. 

If you enjoy the game, support the developers and add the game to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2961120/Shop_Crush/
